label: Baseball
depicts: Baseball bat shape beside a small round ball near the upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a baseball bat with a separate round ball beside it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stitched baseball when the icon should stay a simple round ball.

label: Bed
depicts: Side view bed frame with one pillow inside one large blanket block
use_when: Use when the interface wants a side view bed with a visible pillow and blanket block.
avoid_when: Do not use for the front facing bed when the mattress should face the viewer directly.

label: Bed
depicts: Front facing bed frame with one centered headboard panel and two short legs
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bed seen from the front with the headboard above the mattress.
avoid_when: Do not use for the side view bed when the pillow and blanket block should be seen in profile.

label: Bedside Table
depicts: Bedside cabinet with a top drawer two door handles and two short feet
use_when: Use when the interface wants a nightstand with one drawer above two cabinet doors.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two door bedside cabinet when the top drawer should not be visible.

label: Bedside Table
depicts: Two door bedside cabinet with a flat top and two short feet
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bedside cabinet made only from two doors under a flat top.
avoid_when: Do not use for the drawer plus doors nightstand when a top drawer should remain visible.
